create_robust_regression_model: create a RobustRegression model with n samples, k features, and prior scale parameters
build_data_to_observations: build a dictionary mapping random variables X and Y to observed tensor values from an xarray Dataset
run_get_queries: run get_queries to retrieve the list of alpha, beta, nu, and sigma random variables for inference
extract_data_from_bm: extract MonteCarloSamples from Bean Machine inference and convert them into an xarray Dataset with draw and feature dimensions
review_studentT_likelihood: review the Y random variable that uses a StudentT distribution with nu degrees of freedom for robust regression
